strategies.name: htf_fvg_tap_with_1m_ifvg_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: After 9:30 a.m. New York time, identify a 5-minute or 15-minute fair value gap forming toward the draw on liquidity. When price taps that higher-timeframe gap, drop to the 1-minute chart, require a sweep of nearby 1-minute liquidity, then enter when the relevant 1-minute fair value gap(s) in the tap
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the local sweep/high-low used for the inversion setup. Target either the draw on liquidity or, preferably per the speaker, a fixed 1:2 risk-reward; move stop to break-even once the closest post-entry liquidity level is taken out.
